column3: (Cookie No HttpOnly Flag — session/login cookies are HttpOnly, 15 §8)
(Cookie Without Secure Flag — every cookie is Secure (__Host- prefix), 15 §8)
(Cookie without SameSite Attribute — SameSite is mandatory, 15 §8)
(Missing Anti-clickjacking Header — the only HTML page (login) sends X-Frame-Options DENY + frame-ancestors 'none', qaror #57)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration — CORS '*' is refused by the settings guard)
(Application Error Disclosure — errors use the 17 §6 envelope, never stack traces)
(Information Disclosure - Debug Error Messages — same as 90022)
(Re-examine Cache-control Directives — /.well-known/* metadata and JWKS are public and cacheable on purpose: RFC 8414 / RFC 7517, Cache-Control public max-age=300)
(Storable and Cacheable Content — informational; personal responses send Cache-Control no-store explicitly)
(Timestamp Disclosure - Unix — exp/iat/expires_in are protocol fields of OAuth/JWT responses (RFC 6749 / RFC 7519), not leaks)
(User Agent Fuzzer — informational; the API does not vary content by User-Agent)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments — review, mostly third-party docs assets)
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing — set on the HTML login page; JSON API responses tracked as hardening backlog)
(Content Security Policy Header Not Set — CSP is required for HTML (qaror #57) and set on the login page; JSON responses are not rendered)
(CSP issues — review on every change of the login page policy)
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens — the login form is bound to the server-side login state cookie (14 §3); review findings manually)
(Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre — COOP/COEP/CORP headers tracked as hardening backlog)
